tools.name: auditBibliography
tools.description: Audit a whole bibliography (BibTeX / RIS / CSL-JSON text, or a claims[] array) in one call — per-entry fabrication verdict + retraction, plus a corpus summary. Batch counterpart to verifyCitation. Capped at 25 entries; entry `index` is 1-based and `sourceKey` echoes the source file's own key. Read-only.

bibliography.description: Raw BibTeX / RIS / CSL-JSON text (provide this OR claims). Capped at 25 entries; the excess is dropped and counted in `truncated`.

claims.description: Pre-parsed citations (provide this OR bibliography). Each needs `title` plus whatever identifiers it carries (doi, pmid, pmcid, isbn, arxiv, issn, ads, whoIrisUrl), optionally author / year / container.

checks.description: Per-entry checks. Default ['retraction']; pass [] to skip.

screenWithLlm.description: Opt-in Stage 3 LLM screen (requires an authenticated key).

tools.name: checkOpenAccess
tools.description: Check a single work's open-access status and best legal full-text URL (Unpaywall). Read-only.

id.description: A single scholarly identifier (DOI, PMID, PMCID, arXiv, ISBN, or ADS bibcode; prefixes tolerated). Exactly one — batches are not accepted.

tools.name: checkRetraction
tools.description: Check whether a single work has been retracted, corrected, or flagged with an expression of concern (Crossref / Retraction Watch). Read-only.

id.description: A single scholarly identifier (DOI, PMID, PMCID, arXiv, ISBN, or ADS bibcode; prefixes tolerated). Exactly one — batches are not accepted.

tools.name: exportCitation
tools.description: Export scholarly identifiers to a bibliography file format (BibTeX, RIS, EndNote, RefWorks, NBIB, Zotero RDF, CSL-JSON, CSV). Read-only.

text.description: One or more identifiers (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, ADS bibcode, WHO IRIS URL) separated by newlines or commas.

tools.name: formatCitation
tools.description: Format scholarly identifiers into a finished citation in a style — vancouver (default), ama, apa, ieee, cse, or any of 10,000+ CSL styles. Read-only.

text.description: One or more identifiers (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, ADS bibcode, WHO IRIS URL) separated by newlines or commas.

style.description: Citation style: vancouver (default), ama, apa, ieee, cse, or a CSL id.

tools.name: resolveIdentifier
tools.description: Resolve scholarly identifiers (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, ADS, WHO IRIS) to structured CSL-JSON metadata. Read-only.

text.description: One or more identifiers (DOI, PMID, PMCID, ISBN, arXiv, ISSN, ADS bibcode, WHO IRIS URL) separated by newlines or commas.

tools.name: verifyCitation
tools.description: Verify a claimed citation against the record at its identifier — catches the real-identifier + fabricated-title pattern (Topaz et al., Lancet 2026). Pass title plus one identifier. Read-only.

screenWithLlm.description: Opt-in Stage 3 LLM screen (requires an authenticated key).
